sentences.text:
Through: Mr.Sanjay Lao  (Crl.) for   SI Rashmi, 
 Mr.Manoj Ku  respondent   respondent   CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT BANSAL  ORDER % 08.11.2023 1.

The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No. 916/2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 registered at Police Station Baba Haridas Nagar on the ground of settlement.
2. The petitioner no.1 is the husband of the respondent no.2 and the petitioners no.2 to 4 are family members of the petitioner no.1.
The marriage of the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 was solemnized on 9th December, 2016 according to Muslim rites and ceremonies.
One child was born out of the wedlock who is still a minor.
3. Disputes arose between the parties, which resulted in filing of the FIR by the respondent no.2 against the petitioners.
4. Now the parties have settled their disputes before the Mediation Centre, Dwarka Courts, annexed as Annexure C to the petition.
This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: 1 The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/11/2023 at 02:53:55 5.
As per the settlement, the entire amount has been paid.
6. The respondent no.2 is present in Court and has been identified by her counsel and by the Investigating Officer (IO).
She informs the Court that she has settled the matter of her own free will and without any coercion.
She further states that she has no objection to quashing of the FIR.
7. The petitioners are also present in Court and have been identified by their counsel.
They affirm the statement of the respondent no.2 and undertake to abide by the terms of settlement arrived at between the parties.

8. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Hence, it would be in the interest of justice to quash the aforementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
9. There is minor child born from the wedlock, who is in the care and custody of the respondent no.2/mother.
It is directed that the settlement executed between the petitioners and respondent no.2 as well as this order shall have no effect on the rights of the minor child/children in the future.
10. Consequently, FIR No. 916/2020 registered at Police Station Baba Haridas Nagar and proceedings pursuant thereto are quashed.
11. The petition stands disposed of.

AMIT BANSAL, J.
NOVEMBER 8, 2023/rt
